title: Smoky Korean-Style Pork Anju Jjigae
description: A savory and spicy Korean-inspired stew originating from the Korean peninsula, combining the flavors of anju with smoky pork.
instructions: Heat oil in a large pan over medium-high heat.
Add the pork and cook until browned, about 5 minutes. Remove from the pan.
Add the sliced ginger and cook until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Add the garlic and cook until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Add the anju gochujang, soy sauce, brown sugar, and Korean chili flakes. Stir to combine.
Add the browned pork back into the pan and stir to coat with the sauce.
Add the chopped green onions and cook for 1 minute.
Serve the jjigae hot over rice.
Optional: Add rice vinegar to taste.
